description: This file contains pytest fixtures for testing a FastAPI backend application. It sets environment variables, imports the app, and defines fixtures to create a test client, generate fake credentials, and handle login/token retrieval.

methods.name: TestClient client()
methods.description: Creates and yields a FastAPI TestClient instance with session scope for reuse across tests.

methods.name: fake_credentials()
methods.description: Generates and returns a dictionary with unique email, password, and name for testing user registration.

methods.name: login_and_token(client: TestClient, fake_credentials)
methods.description: Handles user registration/login and retrieves an access token for authentication during tests.
